toxicn-taskb-all.classification_categories: Non-harmful, Targeted Harmful, Sexual Innuendo, General Offense, or Dispirited Culture.

definitions.Non-harmful: Private focus profile: look for ordinary humor, daily-life commentary, neutral comparison, playful reaction, or context where no concrete attack, adult-coded double meaning, broad vulgar abuse, or bleak self-deprecating life attitude is supported by the image and text.
definitions.Targeted Harmful: Private focus profile: look for evidence that wording or imagery is aimed at a concrete person, visible individual, named entity, social identity, nationality, gender group, occupation, organization, fandom, game role, or otherwise identifiable target, especially through contempt, stereotyping, demeaning comparison, hostility, or attack-like framing.
definitions.Sexual Innuendo: Private focus profile: look for adult-coded euphemisms, homophones, body-related metaphors, intimate role-play wording, desire, suggestive pose, adult objects, or image-text double meanings that imply intimate behavior, adult body references, attraction, or adult situations without necessarily being explicit.
definitions.General Offense: Private focus profile: look for vulgar words, curses, broad insults, threats, aggressive or contemptuous tone, dirty jokes, or derogatory expression where the target is absent, unclear, non-specific, generic, or framed as a broad complaint rather than aimed at a clearly identifiable group or person.
definitions.Dispirited Culture: Private focus profile: look for self-reference, fatigue, pessimism, failure, collapse, giving up, lying flat, low motivation, being useless, emotional overload, lifestyle decline, nihilistic joking, or bleak self-deprecating humor.
